title: Derive every task-kind table from one typed TASK_KINDS vocabulary
deviations_from_card: (1) app/api/tasks/route.ts and app/api/tasks/[id]/retry/route.ts needed NO edit: isKnownKind became a type predicate and the existing `!body.kind || !isKnownKind(body.kind)` / `!isKnownKind(task.kind)` checks narrow the property, so both startTask calls compile uncast (source-pinned text in tasks-route-tenancy.test.ts and rate-limit-contract.test.ts is unchanged). (2) tsc forced one line outside the write set: app/features/tools/devcases/useDevTabNeedAnalysis.ts retypes its startTask prop from (kind: string) to (kind: TaskKind). (3) perf-budget.json (shared surface, under the lock, own commit 0bb5e9631): named override 226 modules for app/api/jobs/[id]/interview-kit/route.ts, which sat at exactly the 225 group ceiling; task-kinds.ts is a +1 leaf module. (4) New route test file app/api/tasks/route.test.ts carries acceptance case 7. (5) Test and refactor landed as ONE commit (4b70dcbce): the test half cannot be green alone (the provider @ts-expect-error and the profile_draft null are red until the code lands). Docs commit e4ee12435 precedes it by one commit. (6) TasksProvider.tsx types its callback param as Parameters<TasksCtx['startTask']>[0] instead of importing TaskKind, to add no line to a file already over its 200-line cap.
notes: Red before: task-kinds.test.ts all red (module missing), dedupe exhaustiveness red (profile_draft had no entry), route case red on kind='constructor' (the old `kind in HANDLERS` guard walked the prototype: 'constructor' passed isKnownKind and 500'd in startTask - fixed by the Set-backed isTaskKind), the provider @ts-expect-error red in tsc; budget/outcome/pump cases were red as 'still reads tasks.ts text' (structural), and pass after. tsc: 0 errors outside kpi-sim/ - kpi-sim/ is an UNTRACKED foreign directory (a copy of the tree, present at session start) with 26 pre-existing errors; one of them (kpi-sim/.../DevTab.tsx) now also reports the startTask type because the copy resolves @/ to the live tree. CI does not see kpi-sim/. test:perf exit 1 on FOREIGN paths only after my override: app/_lib/llm-config.ts 322/320 KB and app/_lib/job-ingest.ts 403/400 KB - neither graph contains any task module (checked with check-budget --explain; the growth is db/core.ts + tenancy.ts, sibling in-flight work). Unit: 233 tests across app/_lib/task*.test.ts, tasks-pump, features/shell/tasks, features/tools/devcases, api/tasks, late-bound-boot, repo-scan-run, rate-limit-contract - all green. Card B (same context, later wave) touches tasks.ts / task-outcome-summary.ts / retry route: NO_TABLE_SUMMARY is now `as const satisfies Partial<Record<TaskKind,string>>` and TABLE is Record<MappedKind, Mapper>; DEDUPE_BUILDERS is Record<TaskKind, DedupeBuilder | null>.
